items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Gussie might have been in there. ... Except that Larry Shields was taking Gussie's place.

ctx.x: Then I come across some of those I don't know.
That's Paul Whiteman's band. Gussie might have been in there.
I was looking for that when I was picking him out today. I don't see Gussie there.
